name: OneCLI
short_desc: Open-source credential gateway with a built-in vault. Give your AI agents access to services without exposing keys.
author: onecli
description: OneCLI is an open-source gateway that sits between your AI agents and the services they call. Store credentials once in OneCLI's AES-256-GCM encrypted vault and the gateway injects them transparently at request time - agents make normal HTTP calls through the gateway proxy and never see the real keys. Includes a web dashboard for managing agents, secrets, rules, and audit logs, plus a Rust HTTPS-intercepting gateway. This app bundles PostgreSQL (Community edition, single container each). Port 10254 serves the dashboard and REST API (treat as an admin interface - in single-user mode anyone who can reach it has admin access); port 10255 is the gateway proxy your agents connect to.

form_fields.label: Secret Encryption Key
form_fields.hint: AES-256-GCM key (base64, 32 bytes) for the secret vault. Leave empty to auto-generate on first start (persisted in app data). Set it explicitly when migrating an existing instance.

form_fields.label: App URL
form_fields.hint: Public URL of the dashboard as reachable by you and OAuth providers. Used in links and as the base for OAuth callback URLs ({APP_URL}/v1/apps/{provider}/callback).

form_fields.label: Gateway Base URL
form_fields.hint: host:port agents use to reach the gateway proxy. Default (host.docker.internal:10255) only works for agent containers on the same Docker host - set your server's reachable address if agents run elsewhere.

form_fields.label: NextAuth Secret
form_fields.hint: Leave empty for single-user mode (no login). Setting this (openssl rand -base64 32) switches the instance to multi-user mode with Google OAuth - the Google credentials below are then required.

form_fields.label: Google OAuth Client ID
form_fields.hint: Only used in multi-user mode (when NextAuth Secret is set).

form_fields.label: Google OAuth Client Secret
form_fields.hint: Only used in multi-user mode (when NextAuth Secret is set).
